services.name: Digital Application
services.description: Requires the candidate to fill general info about themselves before selecting a time for an interview (upon client request)

services.name: On Boarding
services.description: Enables Documents (formerly My Docs) & shows the Offer & onboarding column in AMS to collect candidates information. Different groups of documents based on region/jurisdiction are ready at service activation time.

services.name: Group Career Portal
services.description: Provides a branded, user-friendly interface for job seekers to explore career opportunities within the company. The page settings will be customized for the employer via this service

services.name: Job Distributor
services.description: Enables distributing the Job post that is posted on Harri to other Job board sites. Service allows job posters to opt out of organic job boards. Can add CC for North American Premium boards (US only).

services.name: Payroll
services.description: NEW HIRE / Connects to a payroll system, enabling the employer to send the employees info to the payroll system. Pay Data Sheet (PDS) allows users to send pay data to their payroll provider

services.name: Privacy Shield
services.description: It will hide some parts of the system for the candidate. so that candidates applying through a career portal will not see the Jobs page to apply to somewhere else, and Harri will not brand all emails sent to them (it will be signed by the employer instead) / Blocks candidate from receiving Harri Job Marketing

services.name: Team Scheduling
services.description: Adds the ability to add schedules, together with breaks, Holiday/ Time off, availability and Schedule warnings, amongst other.

services.name: UK job message
services.description: Changes the name we display on the job application to show the group name rather than the location name

services.name: TTS Dashboard
services.description: Adds Launchpad to Navigation, required for many other services to properly function

services.name: Onboarding Restrictions
services.description: Allows the ability to block hiring managers from moving new hires to OB swimlane under the following conditions to choose from: No signed offer, any pending E-sign documents and/or under -age applicant without at least one attached document

services.name: Auto Load Offer Template
services.description: Allows for Offer Templates to preload based on criteria set by the template when a candidate is dropped in the Offer Column. Fields and offer description (body text) are editable based on permission.

services.name: Custom Swimlanes
services.description: Allows the addition of custom swimlanes in the AMS (applicant management system). Custom swimlanes can be added to individual jobs or from Brand Settings and applied to all jobs. Custom columns can include a message template sent to candidates upon placement in the column. Can include attachments

services.name: Resume Preview
services.description: The ability to preview the candidate resume directly in the speedy screen. Harri also parses resumes into the applicants’ profile / overview details in the speedy screen.

services.name: Daily job report email
services.description: Sends an email to managers summarizing their published jobs (by access and settings) and used job boards.

services.name: Harri Clock
services.description: Activates the time clock via TeamHub. Configures pay frequency, payroll (provider, export type and other settings), missed shift reasons, tips pool, earnings codes and cost centers.

services.name: Right to work
services.description: Helps employers ensure compliance with right to work regulations by providing a streamlined process for verifying and managing employees' right to work documentation.

services.name: ATR
services.description: It allows the administrative and financial information about a job post to be fed through to senior approvers in a business before being able to post a job.

services.name: E-Verify
services.description: Allows initiation of e-verify process from the Onboarding swimlane to verify I9 documentation and eligibility to work. E-verify training, status updates, and reports all visible in Harri UI.

services.name: Assessment
services.description: Adds a swimlane that will send links to personality assessments of integrated partners. Results can be displayed in harri UI.

services.name: Automated Screening Questions
services.description: Allows managers to create screening questions templates per position, where each question set can have its own settings and questions [knocked-out questions & scored questions]. Managers may determine the flow or next stage the applicant would go through according to his score.

services.name: Reason to skip
services.description: Adds a settings section in Talent Acquisition Settings, when you skip a candidate in AMS you'll be able to set a reason to the candidate's application for review. Users add their own reasons in the UI. Can be made required.

services.name: Rejection templates
services.description: The ability of sending rejection messages upon skipping candidates. Templates managed in top-level settings. Can be made required. Delay times up to 24 hours possible.

services.name: Employee Pool
services.description: Allows employees to clock in on other locations for the same brand without being shared

services.name: Job Postings Options
services.description: It activates features for managing internal job postings, including internal/external posting options, live publishing dates, application tracking, and reporting.

services.name: Advanced Interview Scheduling
services.description: Adds enhanced features and functionalities to our existing interview scheduling, allowing job posters to: Add interviewers, update an interview status, create and manage open days, add phone interview scheduling to phone /screen swimlane, add second interview swimlane and/or set custom interview durations

services.name: TCAF
services.description: Requires managers to attest to change in Time Cards, Employees agree or protest changes on next clock in. Provides audit to all Time Card changes. Provides transparency, compliance control, and reduces retro pay. Breaks and Premiums attestations can be configured in backend settings and/or UI.

services.name: LOGJAM
services.description: an enhancement to job post pre-post settings and job post lifetimes that allows users to configure job lifetime values options, and automatically renew evergreen job postings on Harri & other job boards, amongst other.

services.name: Activity Based Scheduling
services.description: Generates shifts by position and for fixed / guide hours based on the weekly sales forecast and adjustments and the client’s labor model.

services.name: Raw Data Reporting
services.description: Adds the ability to pull reports from all enterprises below the GP, including unfilled, filled & live vacancies, time in workflow, and AQAAF reporting.

services.name: General Data Protection Regulation
services.description: Add applicable disclaimers (harri default is all): login/signup, job post, email privacy, job apply, job alert & job apply consent. harri standard text must then be added.

services.name: Interview Questions
services.description: Allows users to add Interview question types (i.e. question categories), a question bank, and interview templates. Templates can be set per position(s) also indicate which questions from the bank are scored / required and not.

services.name: Forced Password
services.description: Expires the session for the Harri Hire app and requires the user to log in again after 15 minutes or if the app is killed.

services.name: Download CV/s
services.description: Allows Admins to download and review CVs/Resumes, enables Applicants to upload resumes and harri parses

services.name: Par Labor
services.description: Allows for Par to be added as template to schedules

services.name: HMAP Duplicate Application
services.description: Allows Managers to view Candidate applications from other enterprise locations

services.name: No Password Quick Apply
services.description: Accelerates “Apply” procedure by eliminating password field from the signup flow to decrease candidate dropoff at registration

services.name: Trust ID full
services.description: Paid integration to help businesses verify the authenticity of documents, such as passports and visas, and ensure that employees are legally allowed to work.

services.name: Trust ID Lite
services.description: Paid integration to help businesses verify the authenticity of documents, such as passports and visas, and ensure that employees are legally allowed to work.

services.name: Ready to offer column
services.description: Adds Column to swimlane and notifies assigned admins a candidate offer letter can be sent

services.name: Demand Forecasting
services.description: Provides sales and guest forecasting based on Sales Feed or upload. This will generate a labor % on the schedule and variance reporting for actual vs forecasted sales (when POS sales feed is active). Adjustments can be made to distribute across an entire day.

services.name: POS
services.description: inbound feed of sales into Harri to inform demand forecasting and livewire data

services.name: Auto Import Employees
services.description: Sends data from ATS to CoreHR (creates the Employee My Team Card from the send to payroll action). This is a 1x action, it will not amend data once an employee has a My Team Card.

services.name: LMS
services.description: offers a centralized platform to deliver online training courses tailored to the skills needed in your business and industry.

services.name: Employee Referral
services.description: All employees receive a unique referral link enabling them to share job posts via email and social media. Referred candidates are tracked. Notification cadences are available for HR incentives.

services.name: Video screening
services.description: Gives the ability to ask applicants to complete a video answering application questions. Instructions can include media, text and questions. User can create their own templates in Interview Questions Bank

services.name: Budgeting
services.description: Allows managers to upload the budget for a location, which will allow them to compare it with their forecasted and actual data. Template provided

services.name: Background Check
services.description: Allows delivery and receipt of background check to applicants through API

services.name: Global Talent Pool
services.description: A place for customers to retain candidates’ information who have or haven’t been selected for a job role. Managers can add tags (e.g. No Show or Excellent Customer Service Skills) to candidate profiles and search through previous candidates in the pool and invite them to apply to new job postings.

services.name: GP Cross Location
services.description: Allows employees to be shared to locations under different Enterprises within the same HMAP

services.name: SMS 2 Way
services.description: Enables applicants and recruiters to communicate via SMS with the ability to reply back via Text without the need to view the comms on Harri

services.name: Fair Scheduling
services.description: Adds Fair Scheduling rules to TeamLive see jurisdictions (see jurisdictions here). Rules are applied via template drawdown menu in FWW settings in the UI. This service flags potential penalties based on scheduled publish date, schedule changes, and schedule / clock-in variances.

services.name: Branded Comms
services.description: Gives Clients the ability to add their own logo & their own version of copy text to selected triggered candidate emails. Can add media to message bodies as of newest enhancement

services.name: Logbook
services.description: Allows users to create and manage weekly tasks and reminders. It helps users stay organized and ensures that important tasks are completed on time. The Logbook can be used to track and monitor various activities, such as scheduling, time management, and task completion. It is a tool that helps streamline workflow and improve productivity.

services.name: Candidate Privacy
services.description: Hides all candidate profile images in swimlanes, talent pool, and Documents (formerly My Docs). This was moved from an admin settings in Harri to backend activation.

services.name: Stations Levels
services.description: Add stations, or shift details to shifts by configuring station groups up to the financial unit level. Define employee station ability with levels 1-5 per group to control auto-scheduling and schedule warnings across locations.

services.name: Job Approval Flow
services.description: It gives admins the ability to control which roles are posted and by requiring their approval. Users can configure approval flows and approve posts from the top level settings / home page

services.name: Onboarding Docs Pre-selection
services.description: Preselects for Managers all documents for NewHire. An enhancement to the on boarding service to avoid manually checking each document in the modal. With recent enhancement, admins can also lock the pre-selection, so chosen documents cannot be unchecked when sending ob documents to candidates.

services.name: Custom Reporting Hierarchy
services.description: Allows Larger customers to set custom report hierarchy for Flash Dash V2. Creates a toggle on this report to switch between HMAP and custom hierarchy view.

services.name: GFE/Anticipated Schedule Service
services.description: for NYC, Philadelphia, Chicago, Oregon, Seattle, Emeryville, San Francisco, Los Angeles (retail), Berkeley, Evanston, and newly added FWW jurisdictions: enables delivery of a GFE (called Regular Schedule in NYC). Tracks scheduled variances by shift days and times and triggers when a new GFE is required.

services.name: Custom Dashboard
services.description: Allows individual users to create their own custom reporting dashboards.

services.name: Unified Career Portal
services.description: A unified job portal is a single website where job postings from multiple companies are published in one place.

services.name: MICE
services.description: Enables customers to customize their jobs portal, add additional media to their job posts, and set their brand colors in the media center. Brands can show applicants their own media and colors (instead of generic / Harri branding) when they have not applied with Harri to any other brands.

services.name: Carri Chatbot
services.description: A natural language processor chat bot that can facilitate text-to-apply with various automations to reduce speed to hire

services.name: Wage Matrix
services.description: Businesses require the ability of setting up wage matrices based on location, position and age, where the system would use those set wages as guardrails for bulk updating wages automatically by the system, where auto wage adjustments are based on their effective dates and employee age.

services.name: Profile Matching
services.description: It activates an AI model to help recruiters quickly assess an applicant's fit to a job posting. Using predictive analytics, it assigns a match level to any applicants with enough profile or applicant info, bringing them to the top of the stack.

services.name: NYC Just Cause
services.description: Enables trigger of a Probation Period Summary email when new hires are nearing the end of their probation period. NYC Just cause regulates terminating fast food employees after this probationary period.

services.name: Instant S&H Notifications
services.description: Admins will receive an instant notification on their Harri Hire app, or a SMS if notification fails to be received) for the following events: a new applicant applies to an open job post or a candidate confirms an interview invire

services.name: Employee Benefits
services.description: Businesses will have the ability to add the benefits information that they offer to their employees. Managers will be able to determine the name, description and add an embedded link for each benefit details. The employees will be able to access the offered link to their benefits on TeamLive web and app.

services.name: Blocked Past Employees
services.description: Allows admins to create a list of employees blocked from rehire across the brand. Any future applicants from this list will be automatically Moved to Skip Column

services.name: Multi Locations Dashboard
services.description: Provides additional functionality to the current HarriLive Dash, where a manager can select to view the aggregated data for multiple locations

services.name: Harri IQ
services.description: Users can create their own custom reports, widgets, and dashboards and run their own formulas with the Data points available. Harri IQ offers a variety of graph types, filters, and scheduled updates to maximize the user experience

services.name: Enterprise Communication
services.description: It turns on Commshub, our communication tool

services.name: News Feed
services.description: allows team members and management to post messages and share information with each other. It serves as a central hub for communication within an organization, where important updates, announcements, and other relevant content can be shared.

services.name: Employee Notes
services.description: provides managers with the ability to add new notes and edit/delete the already added ones. Moreover, notes types are introduced in top business selected level so managers can choose the note type and filter notes based on their type

services.name: Sales Forecast Feed
services.description: Alternative to ABS for the customer to provide with their own forecast

services.name: Tenants Jobs
services.description: To help our clients to advertise for Tenants (these are similar to Franchisees) to rent the property from the customer and assume the right to occupy the pub for an agreed period.

services.name: Document Builder
services.description: allows the users to create their own forms and documents, with fields for manager and or candidate entry, and add them to their desired locations, without having to go back to Harri’s team.

services.name: Reports Management
services.description: Activates and organizes which standard reports are to be shown.

services.name: Indeed campaign management
services.description: allows for paid sponsorships to be executed programmatically via API

services.name: Minors Handling
services.description: Allows the admin to set the minimum minor age per organizational level, so managers won’t be able to add employees or edit minors’ ages who are less than the defined minimum minor age.

services.name: Approval Flow
services.description: Gives the manager the ability to view the following action details and approve or reject them.: Transfer/Share employees, wage/job title , offer letter, on-boarding documents and/or orecast approval flow

services.name: Tips Management
services.description: activates tip pooling and distribution by financial unit. Tips can be pooled and distributed by hours worked daily or by pay period. Variable points / percentages by position is supported. Tips should be added to PDS and distributed automatically.

services.name: Edit profile
services.description: Allows admins and employees (based on service configuration) to edit their emails without restrictions

services.name: NI Auto Assign
services.description: Allows the system to automatically assign and update employees' NI categories based on their age when they are hired or as they age. Categories supporting auto-asign/update: X, M, C, A

services.name: Pension Matrix
services.description: Auto assign the pension % for new employees based on the rules created in the pension matrix section

services.name: Harri Engage
services.description: It enables clients to create and distribute a variety of communication materials, such as surveys, announcements, recognition messages, and feedback requests, fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.

services.name: Harri Academy
services.description: Provides training materials, including guided courses and how-to videos where admins can assign

services.name: Additional Payments
services.description: allows employers to set and define recurring additional/deduction payments on the employee level to be reflected on PDS periodically

services.name: Work Visas
services.description: It help businesses manage compliance by incorporating visa-related constraints directly into employee schedules.

services.name: Dynamic Landing Page
services.description: Provide a landing page dashboard that provides a regional view of sales and labor data. Through this dashboard, the user should be able to drill down to see the insights/KPIs at different levels.

services.name: AI Screening Calls
services.description: The service allows employers to screen candidates through an AI-powered phone call. It becomes available once a CS contract is in place.

services.name: Message Centre Translation
services.description: Enables automatic message translation in the Message Center

services.name: Harri AI Summary
services.description: Provides AI-generated summaries on Sales and Labor, surfacing actionable insights directly within your operational dashboards.

services.name: Operating Hours Import
services.description: Enables importing brand operating hours from an external integration channel
